lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Thursday's special Town Council session, where Council sits as an appellate body on a contested HARC approval for a three-story addition at 208 S Fir Street — a neighbor challenge that puts design and property rights squarely in front of elected officials. Alongside that, the TMVOA board moves to adopt its 2027 budget and vote on a SMART IGA tied to gondola funding, the Ecology Commission takes up a proposed ordinance to phase out gas-powered lawn equipment townwide, and the County holds a special BOCC session touching budget adjustments including wildfire mitigation funds and a Chamber seed-money request.

notable.stake: Council hears appeal of HARC's approval for a contested 3-story addition.
TMVOA votes to adopt 2027 budget and approve gondola-linked SMART IGA.
Proposed ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn equipment townwide by 2030.
County BOCC considers 2027 budget amendments including wildfire mitigation funding.
Housing authority decides on a $160,000 deed-restricted capital improvement exception.
Public hearing on expanded street closure for 2027 Skijoring and Winter Celebration.
